notes_for_editor: Standing status and location are supported by the FFLA list and the county survey. The county survey gives no date or height for Mount Sophie; its Owner column lists Mn MFS, and no builder was found in two WebSearch queries or the sources above. The only visit account is an undated Superior Hiking blog post, and its comments are reader reports. One WebSearch result (a Minnesota Geocaching Association page) was not used because it is user-contributed. Access is left unset because no official source says whether the public may enter. The blog's climbing account is not endorsed; the story says to check with the land manager.
